**Why the model made this decision**  
The model looks at a few key pieces of your credit profile. It saw one recent 30‑to‑59‑day past‑due payment, which pushes the risk score higher. It also noted that you have a relatively low revolving‑credit utilization (about 11 % of your available credit), which pulls the risk score down. Finally, the model counted a large number of open credit lines and loans—19 in total—which again adds to the risk. When these factors are combined, the overall assessment falls into the “low‑risk” category, even though the calculated probability of default is around 46 %.
